description: Read-only. Compares two periods: taps, app opens, installs, conversions and revenue now against before, with the change and the percent change (null when before was 0). By default "before" is the period of the same length just before. With group (channel, platform, link, campaign, country, a utm_* tag, app_version or sdk_version) it compares each row too, biggest first. Use it for "how did this week do against last week" or "why did installs drop". Days are UTC; each period at most 92 days.

compareFrom.description: Start of the period to compare against; default: just before from

compareTo.description: End of the period to compare against; default: from

from.description: Inclusive start: 2026-10-01, an ISO date-time or epoch ms

limit.description: Rows to compare with group, default 10

to.description: Exclusive end, same formats; default now

name: compare_analytics
title: Compare two periods
